provenance: Actual contents are read from a marked disposable database and preserved in each trace. Created from data/schema.sql and data/seed.sql; event dates rebased on the recorded database clock. This descriptor is not a database export.

data.clock_policy: Descriptor creation date above; actual runtime uses database UTC wall clock and records clock_anchor.
data.embedding_policy: Events and conversational cases need no embeddings. Provision with --with-embeddings before retrieval-quality cases.
